visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt and light blue jeans, stands in a studio setting. She holds a light blue smartphone in her right hand, smiling and gesturing towards it. The background features white pegboards with small plants and a gold award plaque on the wall. (2) Close-up sequence showing four smartphones in different colors (pink, yellow, blue, black) lying on a wooden surface. A hand picks up the pink phone, rotating it to show how the light reflects off its surface at different angles. (3) The woman holds the blue phone vertically, showing the screen which displays a news article and then the Netflix app interface. She demonstrates the phone's size relative to her hand. (4) Close-up of the camera module on the back of the phone, highlighting the ZEISS logo. The scene shifts to an outdoor balcony where the woman waves to the camera. A series of photos appear showing her in the same pose but at progressively closer zoom levels, indicated by focal length markers (24mm to 100mm). (5) Screen recordings demonstrate AI editing software on the phone. A finger drags a toy dog image across the screen; then, a photo of the woman behind glass is edited to remove reflections. (6) Close-up of the phone's extremely thin silver side profile. The woman then puts the blue phone into a small black leather crossbody bag, zips it up, and walks away in an outdoor setting with green foliage. (7) Return to the studio setting; the woman smiles at the camera, holding the phone and pointing downwards as if suggesting a comment section.

(2) Rapid narration explains color options. A subtle 'pop' sound effect accompanies each color reveal. BGM maintains a driving energy. (3) Narrow-bandwidth UI click sounds are audible as specific features are mentioned. Vocal pitch remains bright and engaging. (4) A distinctive 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the move to the camera segment. Multiple mechanical shutter 'click' SFX are perfectly synchronized with the appearance of zoom-level photos. (5) Narration speed increases slightly. High-pitched digital 'twinkle' or magic SFX occur during the demonstration of the AI editing tool. (6) A short, textured 'zip' sound is heard. Narration continues with high arousal and positive valence, concluding with a rising intonation question. (7) Final outro statement with a melodic BGM tail-out and a concluding 'ding' sound effect.
